identity_limitations: Mutable receipt call ordinal is unreliable; never deduplicate by it.
Original broker did not record response IDs, successful raw SSE hashes or raw request-body hashes.
Reported sums are logged provider usage counters with input cache already included, not independently identity-verified billing or money.
anonymization_limitations: The grader reviewed candidate code and documents, did not independently execute them; executable acceptance is separate.
README search-tool descriptions leaked arm clues. This was an independent shuffled review with imperfect masking, not proven complete blindness.
One reviewer, four synthetic work types and one repetition per task do not establish general product effectiveness.
